job.title: SAP Source-to-Pay & Operations Practice Lead - w/m/d

tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer & Techno-Functional Consultant | Java & Spring
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting enterprise e-commerce platforms and SAP Commerce Cloud integrations for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, microservices and data pipelines between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Proven techno-functional background in requirements analysis, process mapping, stakeholder management and agile delivery. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP Source-to-Pay & Operations Practice Lead - w/m/d
cover_en.hook: C&A’s remarkable 184-year heritage and ongoing omnichannel modernization make it an inspiring environment to shape enterprise retail technology. Over the past 5+ years building and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I have driven complex integrations, process design, and omnichannel fulfillment solutions.

bullets.label: Solution Delivery & Roadmap Alignment
bullets.text: Worked in a techno-functional role bridging business and IT at Rockwell Automation, analysing requirements, writing functional specifications, and translating business processes into robust SAP Commerce solutions.

bullets.label: Integration & Operations Expertise
bullets.text: Designed, built and optimized end-to-end data pipelines and OCC REST APIs integrating PIM, ERP, MDM and e-commerce channels to ensure seamless product, catalog, and order data flow.

bullets.label: Cross-Functional Collaboration
bullets.text: Collaborated directly with international technical and business stakeholders across global e-commerce channels to investigate integration bottlenecks, manage API migrations, and support production systems.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery & Technical Leadership
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, performed code reviews, and provided technical guidance and mentorship to junior developers within agile environments at Shell and Rockwell Automation.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German work permit, I am currently serving a notice period with a last working day on 15 December 2026 and am available to start on 16 December 2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my techno-functional expertise and SAP Commerce background can contribute to C&A's SAP CoE.

tailoring.why_company: C&A combines an impressive 184-year retail history with a clear vision for omnichannel modernization, making it an exciting place to drive impactful technology solutions. I am eager to bring my 5+ years of SAP Commerce integration and techno-functional experience to support C&A's SAP CoE in delivering seamless end-to-end operations and fulfillment capabilities.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of SAP Commerce integration, process design, and cross-functional leadership experience to support C&A's omnichannel growth.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Dear C&A Team, with 5+ years of SAP Commerce integration, process design, and techno-functional delivery at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am very interested in the SAP Source-to-Pay & Operations Practice Lead role. Based in Germany with a valid work permit, I would love to connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application: SAP Source-to-Pay & Operations Practice Lead - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the SAP Source-to-Pay & Operations Practice Lead position at C&A in Düsseldorf. With over 5 years of professional experience delivering enterprise SAP Commerce solutions, data integrations, and techno-functional process analysis for multinational corporations like Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am well-prepared to contribute to your SAP CoE.

Please find my CV and cover letter attached. I look forward to discussing how my background aligns with your omnichannel goals.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
